name: Upscale / Interpolation Plan
purpose: Apply finishing resolution/frame-rate enhancement only after creative acceptance and source-quality checks.
scope: Bounded generative_vfx capability; must operate on versioned structured artifacts.
out_of_scope: final approval outside owner decision rights
procedure: Validate authoritative inputs specifically required for upscale_interpolation_plan.
Execute the bounded operation: Apply finishing resolution/frame-rate enhancement only after creative acceptance and source-quality checks.
Apply upscale_interpolation_plan-specific decision rules and record evidence/uncertainty.
Validate the named output against its workflow contract and creative invariants.
Record provenance and hand off to qc_supervisor, editor.
decision_rules: do not invent missing upstream decisions
prefer local repair over global rewrite when scope is local
escalate when confidence is low and impact is high
creative_invariants: preserve approved premise/theme/character/world/visual invariants unless work order explicitly authorizes change
examples: Run upscale_interpolation_plan on fixture/project artifact and emit a scored result.
counterexamples: Do not ask upscale_interpolation_plan to "make the whole film better" or override another department.
